notes: custom_only — no public rate card; sales-led. Key primary source is Decagon's own Dec 2024 pricing blog documenting the per-conversation vs per-resolution menu, with the striking admission that most customers choose per-conversation because outcome definitions cause disputes ('arguing over what a resolution is'). Reported deal economics: ~$50k platform fee, ACVs ~$95k–$590k, median ~$400k (all reported-only).

change_events.description: Publicly formalized the dual pricing menu: (a) per-conversation — fixed rate per incoming conversation with volume discounts; (b) per-resolution — higher rate, no charge for escalations, commitments lower the rate. Majority of customers reported choosing per-conversation.

sources.note: Primary: Decagon's own pricing blog (Bihan Jiang)
